purpose: Produce a transparent internal benchmark score without claiming organizer-certified or population accuracy.
preconditions: Author fresh source conversations; existing development examples remain regression evidence.
Derive all eight reference judgments for each primary conversation from the source, supplied scoped policy and exact checklist.
Two reviewers derive references independently, without seeing each other's labels or candidate outputs.
Resolve disputed labels with the user or a teammate before freezing. Do not simplify or discard hard cases merely to improve a future score.
Freeze sources, labels, candidate settings, case order and scoring procedure before any paid call.
Expected grades, reviewer notes, family names and descriptive test IDs remain outside inference.
Establish the paid allocation after the actual prepared-input cost bounds are available; this plan authorizes no spending.

primary_pairs: Customer verification before versus after confidential disclosure; include employee/system attribution distractors.
Verified versus unverified protected action with no confidential disclosure; distinguish identity failure from the checklist's serious-error taxonomy.
Operator insult versus customer/quoted insult with a courteous operator; distinguish speaker and recipient.
Private paid offer versus a legitimate company paid-service route; distinguish beneficiary and actual configured violation.
ordinary_behavior_coverage: Clear initial task versus genuinely necessary clarification
Explicit or logically implied answer versus a real remaining request
Corrected error with its configured deduction
Applicable N/A and appropriate investigation commitments
Noisy call transcript, bot context and internal consultation with correct speaker/recipient attribution
panel.difficulty_constraint: The primary panel must contain substantive noncritical deductions and varied complete score vectors, not seven easy full-credit judgments around one flag. Include unfamiliar supplied policy, a materially wrong recommendation, a real omission and corrected advice. Preserve relevant facts in each paired control.
panel.language_variant_policy: Translate one compliant and one noncompliant primary case into the other two languages, retaining the same facts and expected judgments across RU/KZ/EN.
panel.paraphrase_policy: Change only nonmaterial wording or details; independently confirm unchanged meaning before freezing the expected invariance.
panel.repeat_policy: Repeat one designated case per language with identical source, checklist and runtime settings; compare all 24 repeated criterion decisions.
panel.no_inflation: Primary accuracy uses eight independent primary cases, not repeated or translated copies as extra independent samples. Variants and repeats score robustness separately.

scoring.high_impact_full_credit: No missed violation or false positive across verification ordering, protected actions, confidential disclosures, insults and private paid offers, with both violation and legitimate-conduct controls.
scoring.robustness_full_credit: 5 language/call/role handling; 5 appropriate relevant-change and irrelevant-change behavior; 5 identical-repeat agreement >=95%.
scoring.product_evidence: Reuse current demonstrated workflow and source/export checks; verify actual supplied audio and resolve any newly observed product defect.
scoring.unspecified_partial_credit: Do not invent new numeric threshold bands. For rubric items without a partial-credit rule, disclose the reviewer's point judgment and its evidence separately from mechanically calculated metrics.
scoring.failures: Count failed or unresolved predictions as incorrect for determinate references. Report all failed attempts and repairs separately; absent numeric outputs prevent full final-score coverage credit.
scoring.semantic_review: Inspect all final criterion explanations and decisive evidence, including correct-label outputs. Record invented facts, wrong speaker attribution, unsupported deductions and generic reasoning as substantive defects; matching a label or valid JSON alone is insufficient. Confirm representative complete results survive the API, UI and export unchanged.
scoring.interpretation: Publish the score with its sample size, reference provenance, ambiguities, costs and failures. This is an internal benchmark score, not a predicted hackathon score or a confidence interval for general accuracy.

cost.basis: 17 single attempts at the observed approximate $0.04-$0.08 per comparable assessment; not a provider quote or guaranteed total.
cost.current_control_reserve: Preserve the approximately $0.69 left under the existing $7 delivery authorization for the actual control inputs. Request any additional allocation only after the fixture is concrete and reviewable.
